message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”), plus 4 “Wild” and 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” changes direction). On a player’s turn they may:
1. **Play** one card from their hand that matches either the color or the value of the top discard card, or play a Wild card.
2. **Draw** one card from the draw pile if they cannot or choose not to play. If the drawn card can be played, they may do so immediately; otherwise, the turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | • **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Skip (+S)** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse (+R)** – Reverses play direction (acts like Skip in a 2‑player game).
• **Wild (+W)** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+WD4)** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if the player has no matching color cards; otherwise, the opponent may challenge.) | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, they shout “UNO!” if they have one card left. If they forget, the next player can call them out; the offender must draw two cards. The round ends when a player discards their last card. | | **Scoring** | • The winner scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
 – Number cards: face value.
 – Draw Two, Skip, Reverse: 20 points each.
 – Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.
• If a player wins with a “Wild Draw Four” as their last card, they receive an extra 50 points. | | **Game End** | First player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four” cards on top of each other, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they also have a matching card. | | **No Challenge** | Disallow challenges to “Wild Draw Four.” | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks or add extra special cards. | **Quick Tips** 1. Keep track of the current color and value to anticipate opponents’ moves. 2. Save “Draw Two” and “Wild Draw Four” for when you’re about to win. 3. Watch for “Reverse” in a 2‑player game—it acts like a “Skip.” Enjoy playing Uno!
